coordinateSystem: Unscaled Blender import: (X,Y,Z)=(glTF X,-glTF Z,glTF Y)

basis.measuredFromInput: GLB POSITION and original embedded PNG sampled through TEXCOORD_0; no old R11 geometry used
basis.pose: Palms down, dorsum toward Blender +Z, thumb toward Blender -Y on both hands
basis.cuffColorEvidence: Upper surface at absX .740-.745 is near neutral ivory RGB about (246,235,224); .755-.760 transitions to warm skin about (201-220,166-179,144-152). This is a texture seam/shadow band, not a bone marker.
basis.palmAndThumbOriginal: At absX .84-.90, four-finger strip spans approximately Blender Y -0.014 to +0.085; fused thumb reaches about Y -0.064. Original fused hand is overly thick and has holes.

sourceCut.method: Precisely bisect original source on each plane, keeping torso/cuff side; do not discard complete crossing triangles by their centroids
sourceCut.note: Hand wrist cap is hidden under cuff. Keep the clothing opening; do not bridge garment vertices directly to skin. Inspect each seam obliquely after integration.

implementation.material: Use the same clean stylized skin base material as the rebuilt face/neck. Do not reuse the old baked yellow dorsal/shadow-brown palm colors.

inferredReconstruction: Five independent digit branches and their webs are inferred because original four-finger slab has no valid separations.
Palm depth is reduced while keeping original wrist location, hand span, and thumb direction; joint loop rhythm is conservatively rebuilt.
Left and right share mirrored construction; tiny generation asymmetries are not treated as intentional design.
No nail polish, photoreal pores, rig or expression system is added.
validationStatus: Local evaluated candidate passed both hands with zero self contacts at original 1e-8 tolerance, zero nonmanifold edges and zero degenerate triangles. Actual E2 integrated export must be rechecked; appearance not implied by this geometry test.
revisionReason: Actual Blender evaluated v2 had one nonadjacent palmar thumb-root contact on each hand. Moving only proximal thumb sweep rings outward by at most 0.499544 mm removes both contacts under the unchanged local BVH/SAT check; distal thumb, four fingers, palm and cuff are unchanged.
